objective: Test whether a zero-initialized spatial patch-token adapter inside AST, immediately between encoder blocks 11 and 12, improves MeowAgeNet age classification over the exact cached-tail A0 path and over a parameter-, initialization-, and compute-matched pointwise patch control.

relationship.idea065_review: IDEA-065 wrapped selected encoder block outputs with all-token x + up(GELU(down(x))) bottleneck adapters. Its one-based placements included (10,12) and (11,12), so a plain final-block-output token MLP before final LayerNorm would repeat an already executed module family.
relationship.idea065_result: Nine deterministic seed-repeat adapter-minus-head Macro-F1 deltas had mean -0.00573963 (5 positive, 4 negative; range -0.0822974 to +0.0320305).

nonduplication.placement: Fixed once between block 11 and block 12; no probe and no split-specific layer choice.
nonduplication.token_scope: Only 144 patch tokens are adapted; CLS and distillation tokens bypass the injection point exactly.
nonduplication.mechanism: S1 uses a 3x3 depthwise convolution on the true 12x12 frequency-time patch grid; C1 is an exactly matched dense 1x1 pointwise control.
nonduplication.budget: One width-9 adapter with 14,691 parameters instead of two width-32 adapters with 99,904 parameters.
nonduplication.compute: A shared label-free block-11 token cache is consumed read-only; only the adapter, frozen block 12, final LayerNorm, pooling, and head execute online.

relationship.scope: Internal new-seed representation-module screen on the same 792 calls, 111 cats, and formal-v2 nested roles; not external or confirmatory evidence.

validated_local_pdfs.use: AST 12-layer, 768-dimensional encoder, patch-token geometry, and special-token representation.
Pre-LN AST adapter placements, limitations of simple linear bottlenecks, and local convolutional adapter motivation.
Distinguishes standard adapters, convolutional Convpass-style modules, and parallel adapter families inside AST.

literature_review.selection_limit: The PDFs motivate a fixed local spatial module but are not used to tune layer, width, kernel, seeds, or gates on MeowAgeNet outcomes.

shared_cache.pending_amendment_rule: After IDEA-078 publishes its final schema, amend only cache_manifest_sha256 and resolved paths, hashes, index-key mapping, extractor dependency, and manifest-reported A0 reconstruction values. No method, seed, gate, training, or tolerance field may change in that amendment.
shared_cache.label_free_requirement: The cache index must not store label or cat fields; cat IDs and labels are loaded only from the locked fbank/roles after cache extraction.
required_index_invariants: segment_call_indices equals the locked fbank array elementwise
segment_counts equals the locked fbank array elementwise and sums to 843
call_ids equals the locked fbank array elementwise
source_paths equals the locked fbank array elementwise
every one of 792 calls has between one and six segments
exactly 42 calls have more than one segment
shared_cache.reconstruction_path: block-11 cache -> frozen block 12 -> final LayerNorm -> mean(CLS,distillation) -> segment-to-call mean

adapter.patch_flatten_order: frequency-major then time-minor, matching HF Conv2d flatten(2).transpose(1,2)
adapter.normalization: LayerNorm(768, elementwise_affine=false) on patch tokens only
adapter.initialization_fairness: C1 and S1 are constructed under the same seed. Their down, flattened mixer, mixer bias, and zero up tensors are elementwise equal at initialization; only mixer shape/connectivity differs.
adapter.required_initial_effect: C1 and S1 must be exactly equal to A0 in all 146 injected tokens, segment pooler outputs, call embeddings, logits, and cross-entropy before optimization.
adapter.gradient_schedule: At zero up, up receives gradient while down and mixer gradients are exactly zero; after a fixed nonzero-up probe, down and mixer gradients must be nonzero.

pipeline_definitions.A0_cached_tail: Shared block-11 tokens pass directly through frozen block 12, final LayerNorm, special-token mean, segment-to-call mean, and the common head.
pipeline_definitions.C1_pointwise_patch: Patch-only width-9 adapter with a dense 9x9 1x1 pointwise mixer; matched mechanism control.
pipeline_definitions.S1_spatial_patch: Patch-only width-9 adapter with a 3x3 depthwise mixer on the fixed 12x12 patch grid; primary candidate.

model.seed_derivation_rule: Read successive non-overlapping digest uint32 values in big-endian order, reduce modulo 10000, and skip any base/full-seed collision with IDEA-065 through IDEA-078. The first three values 8058, 2495, and 2473 were eligible.

fixed_training.head: training-role locked A0 embedding standardization, then 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm, and dropout
fixed_training.loss: Globally class-balanced call cross-entropy; each complete-cat batch is divided by its call-weight sum.
fixed_training.checkpoint_selection: Minimum unweighted inner-validation animal cross-entropy with a 1e-6 improvement threshold.
fixed_training.paired_initialization: The common head is built first under the same full seed for all pipelines; C1/S1 adapters receive matched random draws; training RNG is reset after construction.

aggregation.primary_metric_unit: Nine base-seed-by-repeat estimates per pipeline; each pools the four validation-fold animal records and is then equally weighted.
aggregation.split_cell_unit: Twelve repeat-by-fold cells; each averages the three base-seed paired deltas.
aggregation.descriptive_only: The 36 fold comparisons and repeated validation animal occurrences are descriptive and are not independent samples.
aggregation.pointwise_role: C1 is the preregistered mechanism control. It cannot be dropped, replaced, or used to change the A0-versus-S1 candidate gate.

gate.full_pass_action: Retain S1 for later independent confirmation and permit only the bounded claim that local 2D adjacency outperformed the exactly matched pointwise control in this screen.
gate.candidate_only_action: If S1 beats A0 but not C1, report only a possible generic internal patch-adapter capacity effect, make no spatial claim, and stop this fixed formulation.
gate.fail_action: Report every result and stop IDEA-079 without selecting another kernel, width, layer, seed, or post-outcome variant.

execution.structural_preflight: Does not read the unresolved shared cache; validates source provenance, real frozen block-12 CPU forward, geometry, parameter counts, exact initial equality, matched control initialization, and gradient reachability.
execution.cache_preflight: Hard-blocked until IDEA-078 manifest/hash resolution; then validates mmap tensor/index/source/role/reconstruction invariants read-only.
execution.formal_run: Hard-blocked until cache preflight passes and GPU permission is given; the runner rejects CPU formal execution.
